entities.summary: Sweden's resistance to Danish dominance within the Kalmar Union, Engelbrekt's rebellion (1434), the Sture regents, and Christian II's Stockholm Bloodbath (1520) — the massacre of Swedish nobles that provoked Gustav Vasa's liberation war.
